## In the 1380s [Record]

On 20 July 1382 Trakai fell to Jogaila and the Order; the armies then stood facing each other near the town for two weeks. On 3 August Kęstutis and Vytautas were persuaded by Skirgaila to come to talks at Jogaila's camp, where both were arrested (VLE, Skirgaila; en.wikipedia).

## In the saga

Book I's camp: a palisaded field between the lakes and the pines, a requisitioned Trakai manor as the negotiating hall, tents beyond the manor fence, an iron-bound gate made by the Order's carpenters in a few days (the "Iron Gates"). Sound dies inside it.
